modalLead: nextDash checks GitHub once a day for a newer release — a dot on ★, a toast while you are actively using the app, and a manual check in the ★ modal header and Config → Overview. Turn it off under Config → Behavior → Privacy.

items.text: GitHub release check — the server polls the public GitHub Releases API at most once every 24 hours (GET /api/update-status, cached). When a newer tag exists, Config → Overview shows a compact notice above Tips, the ★ button gets a dot, and a toast appears once per release while the app tab is active (update_check.go, update-notice.js).
What's new modal header — version line and Check for updates sit on one row; release summary and personal project link share the row below at 50/50 (whats-new-modal.js, modal.css).
Privacy toggle — Check GitHub for new releases under Config → Behavior → Privacy (on by default). When off, the badge, toast, and update bars disappear everywhere (dashboard-config.js, locales).
Release web push removed — software updates no longer use browser push notifications; in-app toast while actively using nextDash replaces them (push_release.go removed).

Release docs for v2026.08.07 — What's new modal, Config → Overview → Latest update, New features carousel, CHANGELOG, README, MANUAL, and Config → Help recap; DASHBOARD_RELEASE → 2026.07-dashboard-release-v157, NEXTDASH_WHATS_NEW_DATA_VERSION → whats-new-v215.
